# OC script -- the console reference

<!-- GENERATED by docs/console/gen_console_md.sh, i.e. `hacs -c 'print(help_markdown())'`, from the registry of the build it runs in. Do not edit by hand: regenerate when a verb, type or setting is registered. -->

The console of `hacs`: a small, deterministic, hand-rolled expression language over the project's pipeline (cohomology of `SL(2,Z)` with `Sym^n` coefficients, Hecke operators, their decomposition, the extension layer, and the benchmark / campaign / validation harness). Binding design: [P] `docs/console/00-console-interface-plan.md`. This manual is generated; its verb, type and settings tables are the registry itself.

## Running the console

```
OC script console (console phase C1a).
Usage:
  hacs --console | -i          Interactive session (prompt 'oc> ').
  hacs --script <file.oc> [name=value]...
                                        Run a script; parameters are read as args.name.
  hacs -c '<code>'             Run one line of OC script.
  hacs -                       Run the script on standard input.
Modifiers:
  --set key=value                       Apply a session setting before the first statement.
  --log <file>                          Append the transcript (inputs prefixed '> ').
  --quiet | --verbose                   The pipeline's own chatter off / on.
  --script <file> --console             Run the script, then drop into the REPL.
  --help                                This text.
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 usage, 2 parse error, 3 runtime error, 4 failed assert,
            5 a legal setting this build cannot execute.
Language and verb reference: `help` inside the session, `?name` for one name.
```

## Language

OC script is a small, deterministic expression language. The normative specification is
[P] `docs/console/00-console-interface-plan.md` Sec. 3; this section restates it for the reader.

**Lexical.** A newline ends a statement unless brackets are open or the line ends in `\`; `;` also
ends one and, after an expression statement, suppresses its printing. Comments run from `#` or
`//` to the end of the line. Identifiers are `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`, case-sensitive; reserved:
`for in if else set help quit true false and or not expect_error include args def`. Integers are
decimal or `0x` hex, with `_` separators (`134_217_757`), of type `Int` = `int64_t` (overflow is an
error, never a wrap). Strings are `"..."` with `\" \\ \n \t`; `str(x)` and `+` concatenate.

**Grammar.**

```
program    := { statement }
statement  := assign | exprstmt | for | if | setstmt | include | help | expect | quit
assign     := IDENT "=" expr TERM
quit       := "quit" TERM
exprstmt   := expr TERM
for        := "for" IDENT "in" expr block
if         := "if" expr block [ "else" ( block | if ) ]
setstmt    := "set" IDENT "=" expr TERM
include    := "include" "(" STRING ")" TERM
help       := ( "help" [ IDENT | "?" ] | "?" IDENT ) TERM
expect     := "expect_error" STRING block
block      := "{" { statement } "}"
TERM       := NEWLINE | ";"
expr       := orexpr
orexpr     := andexpr { "or" andexpr }
andexpr    := notexpr { "and" notexpr }
notexpr    := "not" notexpr | cmp
cmp        := arith [ ("==" | "!=" | "<" | "<=" | ">" | ">=") arith ]
arith      := term { ("+" | "-") term }
term       := power { ("*" | "/" | "%") power }
power      := unary [ "^" power ]                         (right-assoc)
unary      := "-" unary | postfix
postfix    := primary { "(" args ")" | "." IDENT | "[" expr "]" }
primary    := INT | STRING | "true" | "false" | IDENT | "args" | "(" expr ")" | "[" [ expr { "," expr } ] "]"
args       := [ arg { "," arg } ]           arg := expr | IDENT "=" expr
```

**Two rules to know.**

* **The unary minus binds inside the base of `^`**: `power := unary [ "^" power ]`, so
  `-2 ^ 2 == 4` and `0 - 2 ^ 2 == -4`. This is *not* the school convention.
* **Strings print bare only at the top of `print` / `str`**: `print("dim")` prints `dim`, while a
  bare expression statement `"dim"`, and a string inside a list or record anywhere, prints quoted
  (`"dim"`, `["a", "b"]`).

**Semantics in brief.** `/` on `Int` is exact and an error on a non-zero remainder; on `Fp` it is
field division. `^` on `Int` is exact and overflow-checked. Comparison of objects is mathematical
equality (matrices entrywise). `include("f.oc")` resolves relative to the including file, is
cycle-checked and runs in the same global frame. Pipeline objects are **lazy handles**: a verb
returns at once, the work runs on first access to a computed member, under the settings
**snapshot taken when the handle was created**; a handle whose computation failed stays bound in
state `failed` and is never retried. `?x` describes a value (type, state, settings snapshot,
creation site, members); `help` lists everything, `help <name>` one verb, type or setting.
`expect_error "substring" { ... }` succeeds iff the block raises an error containing the
substring; it is the only error-consuming construct (there is no `try`). Lines a script prints
with the prefix `#~ ` are annotations (timings), excluded from every transcript comparison.

## Exit codes and the error model

| Exit | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success |
| 1 | usage: an unrecognised console argument, a script file not found, an undeclared `--set` key or an invalid `--set` value |
| 2 | parse error -- reported before anything runs, so a script with one has no side effect |
| 3 | runtime error: a console type / arity error, a pipeline contract violation, every `ENGINE_CHECK`, `hecke::HeckeOverflow`, out of memory, a failed handle |
| 4 | a failed `assert(cond, msg)` or `expect_error` |
| 5 | a legal setting this build cannot execute (`hecke::NotImplementedInThisBuild`) -- on a `set` statement, as a `--set` argument, or at a verb or member that does not honour the setting in force (e.g. [E] `sec:ring` (h)'s list under `coefficient_ring = Z/ell^<k>`); never reported as a bad value, never degraded to the default |

Every error is printed as `file:line:col: kind: message`, followed by the offending source line;
a C++ exception names its class (`caused by: hecke::HeckeOverflow: ...`, `std::logic_error`, ...),
and an `ENGINE_CHECK` keeps its own `file:line`. A lazy failure names **both** the access site and
the handle's creation site (`object of type ... created at file:line:col by <expression>`). In a
script every error is fatal; in the REPL every error leaves the session usable, and a verb-time
error binds nothing. `ConsoleErrorValidation` gates every row of this table.

## Verbs

In registration order, which is also the overload-resolution order (the first overload that accepts the arguments wins). `x: Kind = v` is an optional parameter with its default.

### Group `core`

* `print(value: any, ...)` -- prints its arguments on one line, separated by spaces (a String prints bare)
* `show(value: any)` -- prints the full canonical form, ignoring print_max_entries
* `describe(value: any)` -- prints type, state, settings snapshot, creation site and members (same as ?x)
* `str(value: any)` -- the display form as a String
* `repr(value: any)` -- the canonical form as a String (strings quoted)
* `json(value: any)` -- JSON for Int / Bool / String / List / Record, with a proper escaper
* `annotate(text: String)` -- prints a '#~ ' line, which every transcript comparison ignores
* `len(value: any)` -- length of a List, String or Record
* `keys(record: Record)` -- the keys of a Record, in order
* `range(from: Int, to: Int)` -- the half-open range [from, to) as a List of Int
* `range(from: Int, to: Int, step: Int)` -- the half-open range [from, to) with the given step
* `abs(value: Int)` -- absolute value
* `min(a: Int, b: Int)` -- the smaller of two Ints
* `max(a: Int, b: Int)` -- the larger of two Ints
* `type(value: any)` -- the type name as a String
* `assert(condition: Bool)` -- fails the script (exit code 4) when the condition is false
* `assert(condition: Bool, message: String)` -- fails the script (exit code 4) with the given message
* `exit()` -- ends the script with exit code 0
* `exit(code: Int)` -- ends the script with the given exit code
* `vars()` -- every bound variable as a Record
* `verbs()` -- every registered verb name
* `types()` -- every registered type name
* `settings()` -- every setting with its value, source (session / env) and family (engine / mathematical)
* `reset_settings()` -- re-applies the settings snapshot taken when the session started
* `script_args()` -- the script parameters, same as `args`
* `compute(object: Object)` -- forces a lazily declared handle and returns it
* `state(object: Object)` -- state, creation site, settings snapshot and resumable state of a handle
* `resume(object: Object)` -- continues a computation that a budget cut off, with the same budget
* `resume(object: Object, budget: any = nil)` -- continues a budget-cut computation with a new budget, recorded in the resumed handle's settings snapshot
* `display(value: any, ...)` -- forces each declared handle, then shows each argument: in a served notebook as a rendered value (one value frame each, like a bare expression), elsewhere as the full canonical form (like show)

### Group `arithmetic`

* `Fp(p: Int, a: Int)` -- the element a of F_p, as a canonical residue
* `poly(p: Int, coeffs: List)` -- the polynomial with the given coefficients LOW -> HIGH over F_p
* `X(p: Int)` -- the indeterminate X over F_p
* `coeffs(f: Poly)` -- the coefficients LOW -> HIGH (the machine order; the print form is HIGH -> LOW)
* `degree(f: Poly)` -- the degree, -1 for the zero polynomial
* `factor(f: Poly)` -- the certified factorisation of f (always passed through CertifyFactorization)
* `gcd(f: Poly, g: Poly)` -- the monic gcd
* `powmod(g: Poly, e: Int, f: Poly)` -- g^e mod f
* `eval(f: Poly, x: Int)` -- f(x) in F_ell
* `matrix(p: Int, rows: List)` -- a matrix over F_p from a list of equal-length rows
* `identity(p: Int, n: Int)` -- the n x n identity over F_p
* `zero(p: Int, rows: Int, cols: Int)` -- the zero matrix over F_p
* `mul(a: any, b: any)` -- the product of two matrices or two polynomials
* `add(a: any, b: any)` -- the sum of two matrices or two polynomials
* `sub(a: any, b: any)` -- the difference of two matrices or two polynomials
* `scale(A: Matrix, c: Int)` -- c * A
* `rank(A: Matrix)` -- the rank of A
* `nullity(A: Matrix)` -- cols(A) - rank(A)
* `rref(A: Matrix)` -- the reduced row echelon form of A
* `kernel(A: Matrix)` -- a basis of ker A, one column per basis vector
* `image(A: Matrix)` -- a basis of the column space of A, one column per basis vector
* `column_space(A: Matrix)` -- a basis of the column space of A (the name plan Sec. 3.5 uses)
* `inverse(A: Matrix)` -- A^{-1}
* `transpose(A: Matrix)` -- A^T
* `pow(A: Matrix, e: Int)` -- A^e for a square A and e >= 0 (A^0 = I)
* `solve(A: Matrix, B: Matrix)` -- the exact X with A*X = B (A of full column rank; typed error otherwise)
* `hstack(parts: List)` -- the parts side by side
* `vstack(parts: List)` -- the parts stacked
* `submatrix(A: Matrix, r0: Int, r1: Int, c0: Int, c1: Int)` -- the half-open block A[r0:r1, c0:c1]
* `columns(A: Matrix, idx: List)` -- the listed columns of A, in the order given
* `vec(A: Matrix)` -- A as one column, ROW-MAJOR (SubspaceOps' convention)
* `unvec(v: Matrix, rows: Int, cols: Int)` -- the inverse of vec
* `sum_spaces(U: Matrix, V: Matrix)` -- a basis of the column span of [U | V]
* `intersect(U: Matrix, V: Matrix)` -- a basis of the intersection of the two column spans
* `contains(U: Matrix, v: Matrix)` -- whether v lies in the column span of U
* `in_span(list: List, A: Matrix)` -- whether A lies in the F_ell-span of the listed matrices
* `restrict(A: Matrix, basis: Matrix)` -- the matrix of A on the invariant subspace spanned by the basis columns
* `algebra(ops: List)` -- the unital F_ell-algebra generated by pairwise-commuting operators: {dim, basis}
* `commutant(ops: List)` -- {X : X A = A X for every A in ops}: {dim, basis}
* `is_cyclic(ops: List, v: Matrix)` -- whether F_ell[ops] . v is the whole space
* `cyclic_vector(ops: List, seed: Int)` -- a cyclic vector for F_ell[ops], from a MANDATORY seed
* `random_vector(p: Int, n: Int, seed: Int)` -- a SplitMix64 vector; the seed is mandatory, so it is reproducible
* `random_matrix(p: Int, rows: Int, cols: Int, seed: Int)` -- a SplitMix64 matrix; the seed is mandatory
* `jordan_type(A: Matrix)` -- the Jordan partition of a NILPOTENT A, from the nullities of its powers
* `charpoly(A: Matrix)` -- the characteristic polynomial (Berkowitz; division-free)
* `minpoly(A: Matrix)` -- the minimal polynomial (Krylov)
* `trace(A: Matrix)` -- the trace in F_p
* `eval_at(f: Poly, A: Matrix)` -- f(A)

### Group `pipeline`

* `sl2z_model()` -- the 7-vertex SL(2,Z) orbifold model with its exact tessellation tables
* `sl2z_model(name: String)` -- the named model descriptor (this build ships 'sl2z_7vertex')
* `models()` -- the model names this build can build
* `sphere(n: Int)` -- the simplicial n-sphere (n = 1, 2, 3)
* `cylinder()` -- the simplicial cylinder
* `moebius()` -- the simplicial Moebius band
* `projective_plane()` -- the simplicial projective plane
* `complex(simplices: List, name: String)` -- a complex from its simplex lists, grouped by dimension
* `symmetric_power(model: Model, n: Int, ell: Int)` -- the local system Sym^n(F_ell^2) on the model
* `cohomology(L: LocalSystem)` -- H^*_eq(K, R; L) -- lazy: the work runs on the first computed access
* `dickson_exceptional(n: Int, ell: Int)` -- whether (n, ell) is on the Dickson-invariant exceptional locus
* `dickson_count(n: Int, ell: Int)` -- #{(a, b) >= 0 : a(ell+1) + b(ell^2-ell) = n}
* `hecke(H: Cohomology, p: Int)` -- T_p on H^* (this IS U_ell when p == ell -- the same code path)
* `hecke(H: Cohomology, p: Int, r: Int = 1)` -- the primitive double-coset pipeline for N = p^r
* `family(H: Cohomology)` -- the Hecke operator family on H^* (32-bit only)
* `dual(L: LocalSystem)` -- the contragredient D_n of a model local system (E7; lazy)
* `pairing(L: LocalSystem, D: ContragredientLocalSystem)` -- the Poincare-duality pairing between H_c(L) and H(D), D = dual(L) (E7; lazy)
* `s1_scalar(scalar: Int, ell: Int)` -- the rank-1 local system on S^1 with scalar monodromy (a preset: no Hecke action)
* `s1_unipotent(ell: Int)` -- the rank-2 unipotent local system on S^1 (a preset: no Hecke action)
* `cylinder_scalar(scalar: Int, ell: Int)` -- the scalar-monodromy local system on the cylinder
* `cylinder_unipotent(ell: Int)` -- the rank-2 unipotent local system on the cylinder
* `moebius_scalar(scalar: Int, ell: Int)` -- the scalar-twist local system on the Moebius band
* `moebius_unipotent(ell: Int)` -- the rank-2 unipotent local system on the Moebius band
* `decompose(ops: any, q: Int)` -- the certified primary decomposition of H^q over a commuting Hecke family (one operator or a list of them); q is mandatory
* `report(D: Decomposition, level_a: Bool = false)` -- the hecke_report/v2 record of the decomposition's degree
* `report(D: Decomposition, level_a: Bool = false, path: String = "")` -- the hecke_report/v2 record of the decomposition's degree, also written to a file
* `crosschecks(T: HeckeOperator)` -- the classical alpha/beta/omega factorization checks (i)/(ii)/(iii) against the fused pipeline -- expensive in p

### Group `reproducibility`

* `hash(x: any)` -- the per-kind FNV-1a-64 of the golden harness, as canonical 0x... text
* `hash_int(x: any)` -- the same hash as an Int, when it fits one
* `golden(point: String, object: String)` -- the frozen GoldenReference.inc entry {tier, rows, cols, value, hash} -- READ-ONLY
* `golden_has(point: String, object: String)` -- whether the reference has that (point, object)
* `golden_size()` -- the number of entries in the reference
* `fingerprint()` -- the mathematical-settings fingerprint (0x0... at the defaults)
* `math_settings()` -- the mathematical settings in force, with their sources and the fingerprint (read-only in C1a; `set` on them is phase C2)
* `save_state(x: any)` -- the R3 resumable-state object of a handle, as JSON text
* `save_state(x: any, path: String)` -- the same, written to a file (a state over 64 KiB goes to a sidecar referenced by relative path and FNV-1a-64)

### Group `harness`

* `validations()` -- every registered validation as [name, tier], in registration order
* `validations(tier: String)` -- the registered validations of one tier ("fast" / "standard" / "slow")
* `run_validation(name: String, inherit_settings: Bool = false)` -- runs one registered validation in process and returns its code (0 = pass); the session's settings are lifted to its baseline for the run unless inherit_settings, and the validation's own output is captured unless `verbose`
* `bench(mode: String, n: Int, ell: Int, p: Int = 0, r: Int = 1, family: List = List, repeat: Int = 1, lean: Bool = false, cross_checks: Bool = false, count_allocs: Bool = false, inherit_settings: Bool = false)` -- one `--bench` run (cohom / hecke / family / decomp / ext) through bench::RunMode: a record {mode, params, dims, total_s, total_us, median_s, repeats, rss_mb, phases, extra, bench_line}; times are Strings
* `micro(op: String, a: any = nil, b: any = nil, c: any = nil, d: any = nil, backend: String = "", repeat: Int = 1, inherit_settings: Bool = false)` -- one `--bench micro` op (gemm / gemv / rref / kernel / transpose / suite) with up to four integer arguments; backend "" = the ENGINE_BACKEND default
* `campaign_spec(path: String)` -- parses a campaign spec file (relative to the running script)
* `campaign_spec_text(text: String)` -- parses campaign spec text
* `campaign_plan(spec: CampaignSpec)` -- the plan: one {signature, jobs} record per shape group, in execution order
* `run_campaign(spec: CampaignSpec, output: String = "", inherit_settings: Bool = false)` -- runs the campaign (writes one JSON per job, index.json and summary.tsv under `output`, default the spec's output_dir): {output_dir, ran, skipped, failed, jobs, summary_tsv, index_json, wall_s}
* `golden_subset(cells: List, inherit_settings: Bool = false)` -- recomputes every golden object of the [n, ell] cells and compares both tiers: {mismatches, digest, records}
* `timed(x: any)` -- forces a declared handle and times it: {value, wall_s, wall_us, peak_rss_mb, peak_rss_kb, allocs, alloc_bytes} (peak RSS is the PROCESS high-water mark)
* `bench_line(record: Record)` -- prints the record's `BENCH ...` line as a `#~` annotation
* `bench_line(record: Record, mode: String)` -- the same, naming the mode of a timed() record
* `rss()` -- the process's resident set: {peak_rss_mb, rss_mb, peak_rss_kb, rss_kb, scope} -- the high-water mark of the PROCESS, not of any one verb

### Group `reference`

* `help_markdown()` -- the console reference manual (docs/console/console.md) as Markdown, generated from this registry -- [P]'s `help --markdown`

### Group `extension`

* `sturm_bound(k: Int, ell: Int)` -- the computed Sturm bound B'(k, ell) at the default cap 12*B(k)
* `sturm_bound(k: Int, ell: Int, cap: Int = 0)` -- the same with the cap pinned
* `u_ell_decision(n: Int, ell: Int)` -- whether U_ell fits the `u_ell` budget in force, by the frozen RSS model
* `u_ell_decision(n: Int, ell: Int, budget_mb: Int)` -- the same against an explicit budget in MB
* `bernoulli_mod(w: Int, ell: Int)` -- B_w in F_ell by the F_ell recursion (von Staudt-Clausen: defined exactly for 0 <= w < ell - 1, refused outside it)
* `glover_factors(n: Int, ell: Int)` -- the Glover / Ash-Stevens composition factors Sym^{n_i} (x) det^{j_i} of Sym^n(F_ell^2) over F_ell[GL_2(F_ell)], with multiplicities, in the PIPELINE's convention: Sym^n of the STANDARD module (not its dual), the one rho_n acts on -- the dual would shift every det_twist by -n
* `canonical_field_polynomial(ell: Int, r: Int)` -- C_{ell,r}, the defining polynomial of the degree-r split field, as the `field_polynomial` setting in force selects it: `least` (the default) gives the CanonicalLess-least monic irreducible of [E] def:canon; `conway` is a legal value this build cannot execute (exit code 5)
* `nilpotent_part(A: Matrix)` -- the nilpotent part n of A = s + n (Jordan-Chevalley over F_ell: s = A^(ell^N))
* `nilpotent_part(ops: List)` -- the nilpotent parts of a COMMUTING family (the generators of its radical ideal)
* `radical(alg: any)` -- rad A = the nilpotent elements of A = F_ell[ops] (ker Frob^e), {dim, basis}; `alg` is a list of commuting operators, the Record of algebra(ops) or a HeckeAlgebra
* `tangent_space(alg: any)` -- m/m^2 = rad/rad^2: {dim (over F_ell), local, f, embdim, basis}
* `socle(alg: any)` -- soc A = Ann_A(rad A): {dim, local, f, gorenstein, basis}
* `nilpotency_index(alg: any)` -- the least nu with rad^nu = 0 (1 iff A is reduced)
* `is_local(alg: any)` -- whether A has exactly one maximal ideal (Berlekamp: dim{x : x^ell - x in rad} - dim rad == 1) -- decided, never searched
* `algebra_invariants(alg: any)` -- every invariant above in one Record
* `loewy(alg: any, V: Matrix = nil)` -- the Loewy (radical) series rad^j V of an A-stable subspace V (columns; the whole space when omitted): {dims, layers, f, layers_over_f, length}
* `socle_series(alg: any, V: Matrix = nil)` -- the socle series soc^j V, same shape as loewy
* `check_identities(H: Cohomology, primes: List = nil, items: List = nil)` -- every item HeckeIdentityCertificate defines, at H's cell, as {items: [{item, name, status, detail}], code, k_max, ...}; primes = [p, p'] (default [2, 3]); items 6 and 7 are assembled only when listed in `items`, and an item whose inputs were not assembled reports `unavailable`
* `L_map(H_lower: Cohomology, H: Cohomology)` -- the Dickson map L_* : H^*(M_m) -> H^*(M_n), m = n - ell - 1: {L, certificate, induced, ranks}
* `ext_record(n: Int, ell: Int, cone: Bool = false, sign_split: Bool = false, presentation: Bool = false, sturm: Bool = true, commutant: Bool = true)` -- the cell's hecke_ext/v5 record (Stages 1-5) under the mathematical settings in force (lazy); cone / sign_split add the E4b-E5 / E3 objects, sturm / commutant select the Stage-4 routes
* `local_algebra(m: MaximalIdeal)` -- the local Hecke algebra T_m of a certified-local maximal ideal
* `module_structure(m: MaximalIdeal, group: String = nil)` -- the LoewyProfile of m in `group` (default: m's own group)
* `presentation(m: MaximalIdeal)` -- generators and a minimal relation set of H_m over T_m
* `atlas(ell: Int)` -- Sigma(ell) and S_sep(ell), in process at ell in {5, 7, 11, 13} (lazy)
* `GF(ell: Int, r: Int)` -- the canonical field F_ell[Y]/(C_{ell,r}) of degree r
* `canonical_field(ell: Int, r: Int)` -- the same as GF(ell, r) ([X] Sec. 7's name)
* `gf_add(x: GFElt, y: GFElt)` -- x + y in GF
* `gf_sub(x: GFElt, y: GFElt)` -- x - y in GF
* `gf_mul(x: GFElt, y: GFElt)` -- x * y in GF
* `gf_inv(x: GFElt)` -- x^-1 in GF (x != 0)
* `gf_pow(x: GFElt, e: Int)` -- x^e in GF
* `gf_frobenius(x: GFElt)` -- x^ell
* `gf_eval(f: Poly, x: GFElt)` -- f(x) for f over F_ell and x in GF
* `settings_snapshot()` -- the mathematical settings in force, as a Settings value (math_settings() is the C1a Record form)
* `iota(H: Cohomology)` -- the production involution iota^* on H and its +/- split (lazy)
* `boundary(H: Cohomology)` -- H^*_bd on the boundary circle with r and T_p^bd (lazy)
* `cone(H: Cohomology)` -- H^*_c = H^*(Cone(r)) with its LES and A_c(T_p) (lazy)
* `dickson_les(n: Int, ell: Int)` -- the long exact sequence of 0 -> Sym^n (x) det -> Sym^{n+ell+1} -> Q_n -> 0 over F_ell, ell >= 5, as a DicksonLES handle (lazy)
* `hecke_ring_algebra(n: Int, ell: Int, kmax: Int = 3)` -- the Z/ell^K Hecke-algebra route ([C] cor:stablecert; HeckeRingHeckeAlgebra), ell >= 5, n even, kmax = 3 by default, ell^max(kmax, K_cls) < 2^64, U_ell within the `u_ell` budget: {schema = hecke_ring_algebra/v1, n, ell, kmax, primes, e_max, K_cls, K_run, Lv_run, level_mode, blocks, lines} (K_run = the levels read, Lv_run = the levels at which the module route ran, level_mode = reuse:<policy> | per_K:<reason>; [C] obl:precisionreuse); per block {system, D, free_rank, torsion, rank_T, A1_hilbert, AK_hilbert, K_stab, eps, verdict, stable_cert, stable, cf9, hidden}; a ring exit 5, ell < 5 exit 3
* `theta(H: Cohomology, H_up: Cohomology)` -- Dickson theta = L_* : H^q(M_n (x) det) -> H^q(M_{n+ell+1}), source-indexed (the same map as L_map(H, H_up)): {n, n_up, ell, induced, ranks, ker, image, twist_check, u_ell_zero}
* `lfunction(n: Int, ell: Int, a: Int, M: Int = 2, R: Int = 4, sign: String = "minus", sep: List = nil)` -- the record lfunction/v1 of branch a: L_a(T) in Lambda/(ell^R, omega_{M-1}(T)) of the ell-stabilised MTT measure ([E] def:lvmtt) of the ordinary eigensymbol picked by sep (List of [p, c]; nil = T_2+3T_3+7T_5; the Eisenstein root if it occurs, else the first root mod ell), sign "minus" (r^-) or "plus" (r^+); ell >= 5 prime, n even, M >= 2, ell^M <= 4*10^6: {schema, n, k, ell, R, M, G, u, sign, geometric, form, normalisation, a, vanishes, mu, lambda, readable, lambda_mod_ell, coefficients, precision, values_modulus, critical_values, hash, line} ([E] lem:lvlfunprec: prec(0) = R, prec(t) = min(R, M-1-floor(log_ell t)))
* `kummer_unit(ell: Int, i: Int)` -- the cyclotomic unit eta_i of layer 1 ([E] sec:lvnf) and its Kummer l-th-power test, ell prime, 5 <= ell <= 65521, i even, 2 <= i <= ell - 3: {schema, ell, i, exponents, coefficients, max_digits, v_pi, unramified, lambda_split, not_lth_power, eigen_ok, unit_ok, ell_divides_Bi, oracle_agrees, split_primes}
* `hida_tower(n: Int, ell: Int, m: Int)` -- the Hida weight-tower cell at class n ([C] def:hidatower), ell >= 5 prime, n even <= 200, m <= 3: both readings of the ordinary part at levels e = 1 .. m, {schema, n, ell, m, e_max, K, h, exps, levels: [{e, ord_rank, image_free, charpoly, free_ord_rank, free_charpoly, readings_agree}], lines}
* `level_n(N: Int, n: Int, ell: Int, primes: List = nil)` -- H^1(Gamma_0(N); Sym^n F_ell) by Shapiro's lemma ([C] sec:levelN; the sparse cokernel of the induced module) and the Heilbronn operators T_p (p not dividing N) / U_p (p | N) on it, primes = List of at most 6 primes <= 97, none equal to ell (nil = 2, 3, 5 without ell); ell >= 5 prime, n even, N <= 100, index(N) * (n + 1) <= 1000: {schema, N, n, ell, index, D, dim_S, dim_ST, h0, h1, cusps, dim_cusp_forms, ops: [{label, p, bad, charpoly}]}
* `nebentypus(N: Int, m: Int, n: Int, ell: Int, primes: List = nil)` -- H^1(Gamma_0(N); Sym^n F_ell (x) chi) for the Dirichlet character of Conrey label N.m reduced into F_ell ([C] sec:nebentypus), and the Heilbronn operators on it; ell prime not dividing N with order(chi) | ell - 1, n >= 0, N <= 100, index(N) * (n + 1) <= 1000; primes = List of at most 4 primes <= 13 (nil = 2, 3, 5 without ell): {schema, label, N, m, order, parity_ok, n, ell, D, h0, h1, ops: [{label, p, bad, charpoly}]} (h0 = h1 = 0 and no ops when chi(-1) != (-1)^n)
* `forms_algebra(k: Int, ell: Int, primes: List = nil, terms: Int = 8)` -- the forms side mod ell: S_k over F_ell with its Miller q-expansion basis and T_p on it ([E] sec:forms; the characteristic polynomials), ell >= 5 prime, k even, 12 <= k <= 400, primes (at most 6, <= 97, none equal to ell; nil = 2, 3, 5 without ell), terms <= 64: {schema, k, ell, d, k_prime, precision, basis, ops: [{p, charpoly}]}
* `hida_lambda(ell: Int, k: Int, W: Int, primes: List = nil)` -- the forms side of the Lambda-adic Hecke algebra at one weight ([U] sec:u-lambda): the ordinary parts e M_k and e S_k over Z/ell^W and the characteristic polynomials of T_p and U = T_ell on e S_k; ell >= 5 prime <= 101, k even with 4 <= k <= 200 and k - 1 >= W, W <= 6, ell^W < 2^62; primes as for forms_algebra (nil = 2, 3, 5 without ell): {schema, ell, k, W, dim_M, dim_S, rank_M, rank_S, comm_ok, stable_ok, eisenstein, ops: [{name, charpoly}]}
* `descent(N: Int, n: Int, primes: List = nil)` -- the integral descent record of H^q(Gamma_0(N); Sym^n Z^2) over Z ([C] thm:descentcert, sec:descentpair; slot-24 D6), a lazy DescentRecord: groups to q_max = 3, bad primes, K per prime, char_Z(T_p), the torsion Hecke modules, the boundary pair; only under coefficient_ring = "Z"; primes = List of 1 .. 6 primes <= 97 not dividing N, sum <= 100 (nil = the first three of 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13 not dividing N); N <= 300, n <= 60, index(N) * (n + 1) <= 300 (at the bound about 40 s and 1.4 GiB)
* `hecke_structure(N: Int, n: Int, algebra: String = "full")` -- the record integral_hecke_structure/v1 of the cell (N, n, algebra) ([C] sec:recordschema item 8; slot-25 HZ-REC): status, record_fnv1a64, cert_sha256, the status signature and the hashed body (G0 .. G8) as a Record; only under coefficient_ring = "Z"; algebra = "full" | "anemic" (N > 1); N <= 300, n even <= 60, index(N) * (n + 1) <= 300 (the descent verb's bound; beyond it a terminal REPL asks first, elsewhere it refuses unless confirm = "yes")

## Types

Members marked *computed* force the handle's computation; *structural* members are available while it is still `declared`.

### `Fp`

an element of F_p (plan Sec. 3.4)

| member | | description |
|---|---|---|
| `.p` | structural | the modulus |
| `.value` | structural | the canonical residue in [0, p) |

### `Poly`

a polynomial over F_ell; prints HIGH -> LOW degree, while coeffs / hash use the machine order LOW -> HIGH (plan Sec. 2 C5)

| member | | description |
|---|---|---|
| `.ell` | structural | the modulus |
| `.deg` | structural | the degree (-1 for the zero polynomial) |
| `.monic` | structural | whether the leading coefficient is 1 |

### `Matrix`

a dense matrix over F_p (FlatMatrixT<uint32_t>)

| member | | description |
|---|---|---|
| `.rows` | structural | the row count |
| `.cols` | structural | the column count |
| `.p` | structural | the modulus |
| `.entry(row, col)` | structural | the (row, col) entry as a canonical residue |

| member | | description |

| `.vertices` | structural | the vertex count |

| member | | description |

### `Cohomology`

H^q_eq(K, R; L) with its C / Z / B / H bases and projectors (lazy); over Z/ell^k (coefficient_ring, ell >= 5) its lengths, invariant factors and K-mode

| member | | description |
|---|---|---|
| `.computed` | structural | whether compute_cohomology() has run |
| `.dims` | computed | dim H^q for every degree q |
| `.ell` | computed | the coefficient prime |
| `.d_V` | computed | the representation dimension |
| `.q_max` | computed | the top degree of THIS complex (derived) |
| `.truncated` | computed | false on a finite model |
| `.q_max_source` | computed | 'derived' unless truncated (E9) |
| `.degrees` | computed | [0 .. q_max], derived |
| `.coefficient_ring` | structural | the ring's canonical text: F_ell, or Z/ell^<k> ([E] sec:ring (a)) |
| `.lengths` | computed | the composition length of H^q over Z/ell^k, q = 0, 1, 2 (lengths_H^q) |
| `.ladic_type_certified` | computed | whether the K-mode certifies the Z_(ell)-type at K = k ([E] sec:ring (d)) |
| `.precision` | computed | on a digit handle (ell^k >= 2^64): the certified precision bound -- {precision_requested, precision_working, e_max, word_level, precision_certified, digit_width, digits_L} |
| `.bockstein_rank` | computed | bockstein_rank^0: the rank of beta^0 on H^0(F_ell), from the Z/ell^2 and F_ell objects ([E] sec:ring (d), (g)) |
| `.higher_torsion_count` | computed | dim H^0(F_ell) - bockstein_rank^0 ([E] sec:ring (d)) |
| `.C(q)` | computed | a basis of C^q_eq, one N_q x d_V cochain per element |
| `.Z(q)` | computed | a basis of Z^q_eq |
| `.B(q)` | computed | a basis of B^q_eq |
| `.H(q)` | computed | a basis of H^q_eq |
| `.P(q)` | computed | the projector C^q_flat -> H^q coordinates (legacy shape conventions) |
| `.dim_C(q)` | computed | dim C^q_eq (available even in the memory-lean mode) |
| `.invariant_factors(q)` | computed | H^q = (+)_i Z/ell^{e_i}: the exponents e_i, descending (invariant_factors_H^q) |
| `.r_K(q)` | computed | r_K(d^q) for q in {0, 1}: the K-mode's rank of the coboundary |
| `.ladic_type(q)` | computed | {free_rank, torsion} of H^q(C)_(ell); defined only at a certified level (else the object's named std::logic_error) |
| `.red(q)` | computed | red_H^q: H^q(Z/ell^k) -> H^q(F_ell), the (c5) matrix from the cyclic summands to the F_ell object's D5b basis, over F_ell |

### `HeckeOperator`

T_p (or U_ell, the same path) on H^*: the coset tables, the certified tau datum and the assembled Theta / A^{(q)}

| member | | description |
|---|---|---|
| `.p` | structural | the Hecke prime |
| `.r` | structural | the exponent of N = p^r |
| `.cosets` | computed | the number of cosets m |
| `.certificates` | computed | the in-process certificate bundle compute() already ran (O12(a) and the counters) |
| `.json` | computed | the operator's own report JSON (levels (a) + (b)) |
| `.dims` | computed | dim H^q of the underlying complex |
| `.coefficient_ring` | structural | the ring's canonical text: F_ell, or Z/ell^<k> ([E] sec:ring (a)) |
| `.charpoly_free` | computed | over Z/ell^k: {precision, coeffs} -- the charpoly of A^{(1)}(T_p) on the free quotient, over Z/ell^precision, coefficients low -> high; defined only at a certified level |
| `.A(q)` | computed | A^{(q)}(T_p), the cohomology-level matrix in degree q (over Z/ell^k: the (c5) matrix on the cyclic summands, a List of rows, entry (i, j) in [0, ell^{e_i})) |
| `.Theta(q)` | computed | Theta^{(q)}_flat on the flat cochains C^q(K; V) |
| `.Theta_eq(q)` | computed | Theta^{(q)} restricted to C^q_eq in the stored C_eq basis |
| `.apply(q, v)` | computed | Theta^{(q)} applied to a flat cochain (the fused route) |
| `.apply_route2(q, v)` | computed | the INDEPENDENT second route of [C, eq:heckechain] on the same cochain (matrix-free; it does not read the fused tables) |

### `Family`

the Hecke operator family on one cohomology: T_p, T_{p^r} (recursion and the independent direct route), T_n and the diamond T(p,p)

| member | | description |
|---|---|---|
| `.T(p)` | computed | T_p per degree (this IS U_ell at p = ell) |
| `.T_pow(p, r)` | computed | the FULL T_{p^r} by the algebra recursion of [C, thm:relations] |
| `.T_pow_direct(p, r)` | computed | the same operator by the INDEPENDENT double-coset route -- what T_pow is cross-checked against |
| `.T_pow_primitive(p, r)` | computed | the PRIMITIVE double-coset operator T'_{p^r} (equal to T_p at r = 1; it differs from the standard T_{p^r} for r >= 2) |
| `.T_n(n)` | computed | T_n for a composite index n |
| `.T_pp(p)` | computed | the diamond T(p,p) = p^n I ([C, prop:diamond]) |
| `.theta(p, q)` | computed | Theta^{(q)}_flat of the family's r = 1 pipeline for p |

### `ContragredientLocalSystem`

D_n = Sym^n(F_ell^2)^vee on the 7-vertex model (rho_n^vee(h) = rho_n(adj h)^T), its cohomology, Phi_n : M_n -> D_n and the Hecke action A(D_n)(T_p) (E7; lazy)

| member | | description |
|---|---|---|
| `.n` | structural | the symmetric power |
| `.p` | structural | the coefficient prime ell |
| `.d_V` | structural | dim D_n = n + 1 |
| `.coefficient_ring` | structural | F_ell (E7 is a field object) |
| `.phi_is_isomorphism` | structural | whether Phi_n (x) F_ell is an isomorphism, i.e. n < ell ([C] lem:symdual) |
| `.dims` | computed | dim H^q(Gamma; D_n) for every degree q (golden dim_H_Dn^q) |
| `.dims_M` | computed | dim H^q(Gamma; M_n), the standard module, for comparison |
| `.Phi` | computed | Phi_n : M_n -> D_n, (n+1) x (n+1) over F_ell |
| `.induced_Phi(q)` | computed | P^q = H^q(Phi_n) : H^q(M_n) -> H^q(D_n) |
| `.A(p, q)` | computed | A(D_n)(T_p)^q, the Hecke action on H^q(D_n) (U_ell at p = ell); charpoly(D.A(p, q)) is the golden charpoly_A_Dn(T_p)^q |
| `.A_M(p, q)` | computed | A(M_n)(T_p)^q on the standard module, built from the SAME coset / tau data |
| `.intertwines(p)` | computed | {q0, q1, q2}: whether A(D_n)(T_p) P^q == P^q A(M_n)(T_p) exactly (UNTWISTED, factor 1; [C] prop:pairing) |

### `Pairing`

the cone-level pairing H^t_c(M_n) x H^{2-t}(D_n) -> F_ell and the circle pairing: Grams, perfectness, the PD adjointness gate of [C] cl:pd (E7; lazy)

| member | | description |
|---|---|---|
| `.coefficient_ring` | structural | F_ell (E7 is a field object) |
| `.certificate` | computed | the pairing certificate re-derived: {failing, failing_items} |
| `.perfect(t)` | computed | whether the cone pairing in H_c degree t is perfect (golden pairing_perfect^t) |
| `.gram(t)` | computed | G^t: dim H^t_c x dim H^{2-t}(D_n) (golden pairing_matrix^t) |
| `.boundary_perfect(s)` | computed | whether the circle pairing in degree s is perfect |
| `.boundary_gram(s)` | computed | the circle Gram in degree s |
| `.pd_gate(primes)` | computed | {t0, t1, t2}: A_c^{(t)T} G^t == G^t A(D_n)^{(2-t)} for EVERY p in `primes` (factor 1; t = 0 vacuous and true); at primes [2, 3, 5] it is the golden pd_adjoint^t. A TEST of [C] cl:pd, which is open |

| `.charpoly_factored` | computed | per p: {p, status (ok \| unavailable), expanded, factored ("(X + 24)^2 (X - 2049)"), factors: [{coefficients (high -> low, String), degree, multiplicity, irreducible}], complete, verified, note} -- char_Z(T_p \| H^1/tors) factored over Z (Yun + Zassenhaus, exact; the product of the factors is checked against char_Z); presentation only, not in the record's JSON or digest |
| `.torsion` | computed | per (q, ell): {q, ell, exponents, module_certified, ops: [{p, invariants}], refused} -- the torsion Hecke module by its choice-free invariants (prop:torsionhecke(1)) |

| `.pair_inv` | computed | the boundary pair's groups as structures: {bulk, boundary, compact}, each a List over q = 0 .. 4 of {free_rank, torsion: [[p, k, mult], ...]} (the same groups as `pair`) |

| `.refusal` | computed | the first refused part's reason ("" when ok) |
| `.digest` | computed | record_fnv1a64: FNV-1a-64 of the record's invariants and the settings' canonical text |
| `.json` | computed | the record as one JSON line (schema integral_descent_record/v1) |
| `.module(ell, K)` | structural | H^1(Gamma_0(N); Sym^n Z^2) (x) Z/ell^K with T_p (p in primes) by cochain-level lifts (slot-25 EXPORT; [C] prop:torsionhecke, prop:strictliftN): {N, n, ell, K, K_max, route, carrier, status (ok \| blocked(export) \| refused), refusal, free_rank, torsion (exponents at K), invariant_factors, generators: [{kind, exponent, cocycle (a cocycle mod ell^K)}], ops: [{p, matrix (column convention, row i mod ell^exponent_i), charpoly_free (high -> low, mod ell^K)}]}; one run at the route's width serves every K <= K_max (computed on the first call per ell; it does not force the record); ell in {2, 3}: the tree model, ell >= 5: the cokernel presentation (K_max <= 1 for ell >= 46341) |
| `.module_Z(mode)` | computed | H^1(Gamma_0(N); Sym^n Z^2) over Z as a presented Z[T_p]-module ([C] prop:torsionhecke): T_p = [[tau, M], [0, F]] in generators torsion first, then free; module_Z() = EXPORT-Z step 2 (F exact over Z), module_Z("local") = step 1 (slot-25 EXPORT-Z, F pending). {N, n, primes, status (ok \| blocked(export)), refusal, splitting (export_retraction/v1), retractions: [{ell, route, K_run, K, fnv, [step 2: pi_B (t_ell x r, row a mod d_a: the retraction on B, the torsion coordinates of the classes [b_j]), pi_B_fnv]}], torsion_primes, largest_torsion_prime, invariant_factors (the elementary divisors d_i = ell^sigma_i, ell ascending; key name kept), torsion_generators: [{ell, exponent, d}], free_rank (a blocked value prints these four as "blocked"), free_block (step 2: "exact", or "refused" with free_refusal; local: "pending(step 2)"), M_basis (step 2: global, M in the basis B; local: M's ell-block is against module(ell, K)'s free generators), entry_encoding (step 2: exact, F as decimal integer strings; local: word), split (unknown), presentation, [step 2: basis: {rule (iso_dixon/v3), q0, saturation (det_pm1), basis_fnv, phi_fnv, bits_B, bits_Phi, bound (phi0 \| phi_cert by the Auto size rule; - at rank 0)}, free_refusal], ops: [{p, tau (row i mod d_i, block-diagonal over ell), M: [{ell, K, matrix}] (step 2: against the classes [b_j] of B, T_p b_j = sum_i F_ij b_i + sum_a M_aj g_a, i.e. M = M_local C - pi_B F + tau pi_B; local: against module(ell, K)'s free generators), F (step 2: r x r decimal strings; local: "pending(step 2)"), F_local: [{ell, modulus, matrix}] (the export's free block mod ell^K, not F), charpoly_Z (the record's char_Z(T_p \| H^1/tors), high -> low), [step 2: F_fnv, F_proof (apriori \| apost \| rank0), F_primes, M_fnv (FNV-1a-64 of M over every ell, span convention), C: [{ell, modulus, matrix}] (B in the export's local free generators: C F = F_local C mod ell^K)]}], torsion_canon: [{ell, ops: [{p, invariants}]}] (the record's)}; unique up to [[Aut T, Hom(L, T)], [0, GL_r(Z)]] |

## Settings

`set key = value` changes a setting for the rest of the session; `settings()` shows every key with its value and source; `reset_settings()` returns to the session's baseline. **Mathematical** settings may change a published value, enter the fingerprint (`fingerprint()`, `0x0000000000000000` at the defaults) and are the engine's own (validated by `hecke::MathSettings`); `golden(...)` refuses at a non-zero fingerprint. **Engine** settings change how fast a value is produced, never the value; their defaults are the environment's, so this manual names the variable instead of a value. *env-only* keys are shown by `settings()` but cannot be `set`.

| key | family | kind | default / source | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `print_max_entries` | engine | Int | session | entries printed before a value prints its summary form |
| `verbose` | engine | Bool | session | let the pipeline's own stdout/stderr chatter through (default: true in the REPL, false in scripts) |
| `locality` | mathematical | String | `"budget=64"` | mathematical setting `locality` (hecke::MathSettings -- it changes what a result MEANS, so a non-default value moves the fingerprint and `golden(...)` refuses) |
| `u_ell` | mathematical | String | `"auto"` | mathematical setting `u_ell` (hecke::MathSettings -- it changes what a result MEANS, so a non-default value moves the fingerprint and `golden(...)` refuses) |
| `sturm` | mathematical | String | `"auto"` | mathematical setting `sturm` (hecke::MathSettings -- it changes what a result MEANS, so a non-default value moves the fingerprint and `golden(...)` refuses) |
| `sturm_unavailable` | mathematical | String | `"nonfinal"` | mathematical setting `sturm_unavailable` (hecke::MathSettings -- it changes what a result MEANS, so a non-default value moves the fingerprint and `golden(...)` refuses) |
| `commutant_budget` | mathematical | String | `"20000000000"` | mathematical setting `commutant_budget` (hecke::MathSettings -- it changes what a result MEANS, so a non-default value moves the fingerprint and `golden(...)` refuses) |
| `final_mode` | mathematical | String | `"closure"` | mathematical setting `final_mode` (hecke::MathSettings -- it changes what a result MEANS, so a non-default value moves the fingerprint and `golden(...)` refuses) |
| `field_polynomial` | mathematical | String | `"least"` | mathematical setting `field_polynomial` (hecke::MathSettings -- it changes what a result MEANS, so a non-default value moves the fingerprint and `golden(...)` refuses) |
| `split_field_report` | mathematical | String | `"canonical"` | mathematical setting `split_field_report` (hecke::MathSettings -- it changes what a result MEANS, so a non-default value moves the fingerprint and `golden(...)` refuses) |
| `presentation` | mathematical | String | `"off"` | mathematical setting `presentation` (hecke::MathSettings -- it changes what a result MEANS, so a non-default value moves the fingerprint and `golden(...)` refuses) |
| `predictions` | mathematical | String | `"annotate"` | mathematical setting `predictions` (hecke::MathSettings -- it changes what a result MEANS, so a non-default value moves the fingerprint and `golden(...)` refuses) |
| `coefficient_ring` | mathematical | String | `"F_ell"` | mathematical setting `coefficient_ring` (hecke::MathSettings -- it changes what a result MEANS, so a non-default value moves the fingerprint and `golden(...)` refuses) |
| `threads` | engine | Int | env `ENGINE_THREADS` | the engine consumer pool's worker count (engine::tape::consumer_pool().size()); thread-local, propagated onto run_concurrently tasks |
| `backend` | engine | String | env `ENGINE_BACKEND` | engine \| legacy -- the Phase 2/3 rollback; `legacy` holds engine::elim::ScopedLegacy and forces the legacy cohomology and Hecke-operator arms (thread-local; OC_ENABLE_LEGACY=ON builds only -- an OFF build refuses `legacy`, exit 5) (one of: engine, legacy) |
| `device` | engine | String | env `ENGINE_DEVICE` | cpu \| gpu \| hybrid -- pass 6's device policy (PassOptions); process-global.  `cpu` is the golden path; the GPU is never the default (one of: cpu, gpu, hybrid) |
| `batch` | engine | Bool | env `ENGINE_BATCH` | pass 5, batching (PassOptions; process-global) |
| `ksplit` | engine | Bool | env `ENGINE_KSPLIT` | pass 4, k-splitting of GEMMs with k > k_max (PassOptions; process-global) |
| `arena` | engine | Bool | env `ENGINE_ARENA` | the temp arena (false: every Temp owns its storage) (PassOptions; process-global) |
| `cse` | engine | Bool | env `ENGINE_CSE` | pass 2, common subexpressions (PassOptions; process-global) |
| `fuse` | engine | Bool | env `ENGINE_FUSE` | pass 2b, product-into-AXPY fusion (PassOptions; process-global) |
| `layout` | engine | Bool | env `ENGINE_LAYOUT` | pass 3, layout (PassOptions; process-global) |
| `lean` | engine | Bool | session | the memory-lean configuration of `--bench --lean`: drop the cohomology objects no production consumer reads and skip the Theta_eq solve (A^(q) unchanged); thread-local, captured at a handle's CREATION like every setting |
| `program_cache` | engine | Bool | session | whether compiled tape programs are served from the program cache (false: a fresh compile every time); process-global |
| `confirm` | engine | String | session | a call outside a verb's silent cost envelope (NBCONFIRM): `ask` = on a terminal REPL show the estimate and ask, in a served session answer confirm_required with a per-cell token, elsewhere refuse as before (exit 3); `yes` = run it (hard memory / disk refusals still refuse); `no` = always refuse as before; not settable in a served session (one of: ask, yes, no) |
| `confirm_wall_s` | engine | Int | session | seconds: on a terminal REPL or in a served session, a call outside its silent envelope whose estimated wall time (upper edge) is above this is confirmed before it runs (NBCONFIRM; default 60; serve-settable) |
